response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience and strong TypeScript, Node.js, React, and database skills, aligning well with the role's requirements. His work in energy/geospatial domains (GISCollective, Green Map) and renewable-adjacent tech (Optilyz) demonstrates relevant industry exposure. While his Deep expertise in DLang and niche tech may not directly apply, his pragmatic fullstack approach and AWS/CDK experience are assets. The high on-site requirement is mitigated by his Berlin-based roles.
strengths: Proven fullstack development across TypeScript/Node.js, React, and databases (PostgreSQL/SQL)
Relevant energy/geospatial domain experience (GISCollective, Green Map) and AWS/CDK for automation
Demonstrated scalability and performance optimization in high-throughput systems (Optilyz, Dunnhumby)
concerns: Potential overqualification for an entry-level role due to 15+ years of senior-level experience
Limited PostgreSQL focus (has MongoDB, MySQL experience; no explicit PostgreSQL mention)
High on-site presence requirement may conflict with his preference for diverse tooling (DLang, etc.)
